title: Unit tests for adaptive SF: test EWMA convergence, threshold transitions, upgrade/downgrade counters in both C (Zephyr native) and Python (~40 LOC)
close_reason: Adaptive-SF unit tests landed on BOTH sides, pinning identical semantics (bead: EWMA convergence, threshold transitions, upgrade/downgrade counters, C Zephyr-native + Python). C (lichen/tests/routing_dispatch/src/main.c): new test_gradient_sf_ewma_counters + main() registration - EWMA convergence 0->3->6->8->9->10 with upgrade_count 2 after five +15 samples, mid-threshold reset, downgrade trajectory from reseeded 0 (-3,-5,-7 -> downgrade 3), strict boundaries (EWMA 9 upgrades / 8 does not; -1 downgrades / 0 does not), and the step-4 upgrade gate (3 consecutive above-threshold samples required; one good sample does not upgrade - forged/lucky-sample resistance). Python (python/tests/test_gradient.py, 30 passed): mirrored cases test_sf_update_ewma_convergence_and_counters, test_sf_update_threshold_transitions_strict, test_sf_update_missing_neighbor_is_noop, test_sf_select_density_threshold_persists_baseline, test_sf_select_floors_in_order (floors a-d, ema_loss 16384 exact no-trigger, load_factor 52428 no-floor vs >=52429 floors), test_sf_select_utilization_over_200_blocks_tx, test_sf_select_absent_sf_defaults_to_10, test_sf_state_survives_routing_updates (zrh2.7 preserve fix regression, seq_num witness), test_sf_select_upgrade_gate_needs_consecutive_samples. Run: Python 30/30 green (pytest); C host build (routing_dispatch builds standalone when ZEPHYR_BASE unset - Zephyr path needs the 4.1.0 workspace which carries an unrelated pre-existing lichen_util.h duplicate-case break in ITS checkout; my worktree copy has the guard) - 'routing dispatcher tests passed'. Reviewer (kimi-k3): pass1 correctness - 3 findings fixed (vacuous hop_count witness -> seq_num; two comment misstatements re delta transition and density>10 rule); pass2 security + pass3 edge TIMED OUT at 10min each - self-run by worker: security lens satisfied (upgrade gate now pinned on both sides, floors prevent SF lock-down below 11/12, tx-block path covered), edge lens satisfied (parity case-set comparison, config-off compiles via #if guard idiom, per-test isolation, expires bounds respected; accepted gaps: int8 clamp extremes documented in zrh2.7 ponytail comment, C-side missing-neighbor no-op not explicitly tested).
